title: Sanguine Explosive
summary: Throw to deal 4d8 Force plus 4d8 Fire and possibly burn targets.

fields.Throw: Action, up to 60 ft, 7 ft radius. DC 17 Dexterity save halves both damage rolls and prevents Burning (Orthonic).
fields.Burning: 2 turns, 1d4 Fire per turn. Help, healing potion and Wet cannot remove this variant.
fields.Acquisition: Araj Oblodra stocks two after each qualifying blood donation in the Lower City. Donate once per Long Rest after drinking the Mysterious Potion. No ticking mine.
fields.Base value: 16 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
